idea.blurb: Ask a yes-or-no question and the Pi answers.
idea.code:
import random

answers = ["Yes!", "No way.", "Ask again later.", "Definitely.", "I doubt it.", "Without a doubt!"]

while True:
    question = input("Ask me a yes-or-no question (or type bye): ")
    if question.lower() == "bye":
        print("See you next time!")
        break
    print(random.choice(answers))
idea.title: Magic 8-Ball

idea.blurb: Keep asking until someone types the right password.
idea.code:
password = "pineapple"
tries = 0

guess = input("Password: ")
while guess != password:
    tries = tries + 1
    print("Nope! Try again.")
    guess = input("Password: ")

print("Access granted after", tries + 1, "tries!")
idea.title: Secret password

idea.blurb: Three LEDs flash in a random party pattern.
idea.code:
from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
import random

lights = [LED(17), LED(27), LED(22)]

while True:
    light = random.choice(lights)
    light.toggle()
    sleep(0.2)
idea.title: Disco lights

idea.blurb: Wait for the light, then press as fast as you can.
idea.code:
from gpiozero import LED, Button
from time import sleep, monotonic
import random

light = LED(17)
button = Button(23)

print("Get ready...")
sleep(random.uniform(2, 5))
light.on()
start = monotonic()
button.wait_for_press()
light.off()
print("Your reaction time:", round(monotonic() - start, 3), "seconds")
idea.title: Quick-draw reaction game

idea.blurb: The buzzer beeps when something comes near the distance sensor.
idea.code:
from gpiozero import DistanceSensor, Buzzer
from time import sleep

sensor = DistanceSensor(echo=26, trigger=4)
buzzer = Buzzer(18)

while True:
    cm = round(sensor.distance * 100)
    print(cm, "cm")
    if cm < 20:
        buzzer.beep(0.05, 0.05, n=2, background=False)
    sleep(0.3)
idea.title: Too close! alarm

idea.blurb: Press the button to take a photo.
idea.code:
from gpiozero import Button
from pipath_camera import Camera

button = Button(23)
cam = Camera()
count = 0

while True:
    print("Press the button for a selfie!")
    button.wait_for_press()
    count = count + 1
    photo = cam.take_photo(f"selfie_{count}.jpg")
    print("Saved", photo)
    button.wait_for_release()
idea.title: Selfie button
